newsitem.title: INDONESIA: JAKARTA STOCKS SEEN STABLE ON BARGAIN-HUNTING.
newsitem.headline: JAKARTA STOCKS SEEN STABLE ON BARGAIN-HUNTING.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen stable on Thursday despite generally cautious market sentiment, as some players are likely to hunt for bargains due to announcements of strong first half results, brokers said.
"Most share prices, particularly in the finance and property sectors, are already oversold. I think there should be some bargain-hunting today," one broker with a local brokerage said.
They said Thursday's announcements of strong first half results were likely to bolster the bargain hunting.
Brokers, however, said sentiment was likely to remain cautious due to worries over the volatile rupiah.
On Wednesday, the Jakarta composite index ended down 4.34 points, or 0.66 percent, to close at 658.60 points.
Big-capitalised and liquid banking stocks BDNI, Lippo Bank, Lippo Securities and Bank BII were among the hardest hit.
